bio_am: Ծնած է Վերին Ագուլիս՝ 1873-ին։ Տարօնի գործիչ, ինկաւ Ցրօնքի կռուին մէջ՝ 1899 Ապրիլ 30-ին։
bio_en: Baghdasar Maliants, known as Gurgen, was born in Upper Agulis in 1873 and was serving in the New Bayazet regiment when the 1894-95 massacres stirred him; in 1896, answering the ARF's call, he deserted and in September 1896 entered Van with Bulgaratsi's band. After the planned expedition was postponed he served as cook for the party's gunsmiths, returned to the Caucasus in January 1897, then crossed again and joined Serob and Hrayr in the Bitlis and Taron region. Under the 1898 decision to create responsible committees for the homeland he became one of the ARF's organisers in Taron. On 30 April 1899 he and seven comrades were surrounded in the village of Tsronk near Mush and killed fighting.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Seydo Poghos and others were later buried near his grave.
